Tests that backendNodeId cannot resolve nodes of another target sharing the renderer process.
Nodes of the inspected target resolve:
DOM.describeNode(input): INPUT
DOM.describeNode(template content): SPAN
DOM.describeNode(subframe input): INPUT
DOM.describeNode(subframe template content): SPAN
DOM.resolveNode(input, executionContextId): resolved
Accessibility.getAXNodeAndAncestors(input): resolved
Nodes of a detached subframe are rejected:
DOM.describeNode(detached subframe input): error: No node found for given backend id
DOM.describeNode(detached subframe template content): error: No node found for given backend id
Nodes of the popup target are rejected:
DOM.describeNode: error: No node found for given backend id
DOM.resolveNode: error: No node with given id found
DOM.resolveNode(executionContextId): error: No node with given id found
DOM.getBoxModel: error: No node found for given backend id
Overlay.highlightNode: error: No node found for given backend id
Accessibility.getPartialAXTree: error: No node found for given backend id
Accessibility.getAXNodeAndAncestors: error: No node found for given backend id
Accessibility.queryAXTree: error: No node found for given backend id
